LAWS OF MALAYSIA

LOTTERIES ACT 1952

[ACT 288]

LOTTERIES (BOOKS OF ACCOUNTS) REGULATIONS 1957

(Made under section 14)

(Revised—2023)

[9 January 1958]

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Lotteries (Books of Accounts)

Regulations 1957.

Books of accounts

2. The promoter of any lottery in respect of which a permit under section 4

of the Act has been granted shall keep the following books of accounts:

(a) a cash book; and

(b) a register of tickets issued, sold and returned.

Forms

3. The cash book and the register of tickets issued, sold and returned required to be

kept under regulation 2 shall be in Forms A and B of the Schedule respectively.
